disposition_reason: Tables 1-3 print mean ± SD zinc, manganese, copper, lead, cadmium, chromium and iron (mg/L) in raw cow milk from three settlement points in each of three Kano State LGAs.

study.design: Field survey of raw cow milk and cattle feed at Fulani settlements in three LGAs with health risk indices
study.origin: Fulani ruga settlements in Bichi, Rano and Nassarawa LGAs, Kano State, Nigeria
study.qa: None reported (no CRM, recovery or blanks described)

controls.control: LGA of origin (urban industrial Nassarawa vs rural Bichi and Rano)
controls.outcome: Pb detected only at two Rano points (0.610 and 0.690, unit conflict); Cd not detected anywhere

unresolved: Lead unit conflict: Table 2 says mg/L (ppm), text says µg/L for the same 0.610-0.690 values; recorded as printed with integrity flags, value_ugkg null (per-litre).
Table 2 row labels read BR1-BR3 though the footnote defines RR1-RR3 for Rano.
Detection limits, QA and sampling dates not stated; feed results (BRfeed, RRfeed, NRfeed) not recorded.
Printed DOI 10.22034/jchr.2022.1934016.1345 is an mEDRA DOI with no Crossref record; unverified.
Nassarawa is described as densely populated with industries; site_context set to ordinary for the study overall.
source_record_corrections: Manifest lists doi null; the PDF prints DOI 10.22034/jchr.2022.1934016.1345 (mEDRA, unverified).
